title: PRIVATE TOUR TOKYO - OSAKA BASIC
route: Shibuya - Mount Fuji - Odaiba - Osaka - Kyoto

includes: Public Transport (D2, D3, D4, D5, D6)
Tour Guide (Malay / English Speaker) (D1 airport transfer only, D2-D6) (10 hours basis)
excludes: Extra Hours Transport & Tour Guide: 5,000 - 10,000 yen per hour

itinerary.title: Fuji
activities: Mt Fuji Panoramic Ropeway (known for its retro shopping street and photo spot of Mt Fuji)
Lake Kawaguchiko (second-largest of the Fuji Five Lakes, offering iconic, stunning views of Mount Fuji)
Kawaguchiko-Ohashi Bridge (breathtaking views of Lake Kawaguchi as you cross, whether driving, walking or cycling)

itinerary.title: Tokyo City
activities: Asakusa (Kaminarimon Gate, Sensoji Temple, Nakamise shopping street)

itinerary.title: Tokyo City / Disney
activities: Odaiba (Fuji TV, AquaCity, Decks Tokyo Beach, Diversity Tokyo City)

itinerary.title: Tokyo - Osaka
activities: Osaka Castle Park (second largest park, historical site)
Namba (vibrant, bustling and historic southern downtown, known for shopping and entertainment)

itinerary.title: Kyoto
activities: Fushimi Inari (thousands of vibrant orange, donor-funded torii gates forming tunnels)

expect.title: Airport Transfer
expect.body: Please bring max 1 luggage per person as it will affect car capacity.

expect.title: Hotel
expect.body: Rooms are small typically 12-16sqf (Japan standard). Triple rooms offer even less space.

expect.title: Public Transport
expect.body: 5 days full using of public transport.

expect.title: Stairs
expect.body: Some train stations require lots of stairs climbing.

expect.title: Meal
expect.body: Exclude lunch and dinner. Guide will bring to Halal or Muslim Friendly restaurant.

expect.title: Breakfast
expect.body: Breakfast is only provided if you stay at a hotel.

expect.title: Not Mentioned in the Itinerary
expect.body: Things not mentioned in the itinerary must be paid by customers. Eg: Entrance Fee, Shopping etc.

expect.title: Shinkansen
expect.body: Guests are required to carry their own luggage when boarding the Shinkansen.

expect.title: Tour Guide
expect.body: 10 hours basis. 5000-10000 yen will be charged for each extra hour.

expect.title: Lot of Walking
expect.body: Will be using public transport for day tour.

entries: All prices are valid for 24 hours after quotation submission.
The price is for 2 to 3 persons per room.
Itinerary, price and flight are subject to change accordingly.
Late Booking Surcharge of RM50/booking will be charged if booking made less than 45 days of departure.
Last Minute Surcharge will be charged if booking made less than 3 weeks of departure (refer to the Last Minute Surcharge table).
This package is valid until 31st December 2026 travel period.
Private Driver & Guide is based on 10 hours basis. 5000 - 10000 Yen will be charged for every extra hour usage. Payment must be paid in cash.
Customers are recommended to take AirAsia X flight to Haneda Airport and fly back from Kansai Airport to match the default itinerary.
Please check with our staff on the trip validity or before booking any connecting domestic flights.
Any free activities is non exchangeable with other activities, voucher or cash if the client not joining or due to availability & weather condition.
Final itinerary and hotel location will be confirmed at least 14-21 days before departure.

deposit.text: prior to arrival for full payment
